title: Integrate independent Gauntlet evidence protocol
goal: Connect NERV-owned flow packs and trusted adapters to a pinned reusable protocol without automatic model qualification
acceptance: Existing selected flow runner produces correctly normalized protocol evidence
Planning and deterministic tests perform no inference or downloads
Documentation and candidate profile boundaries match actual support
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; no model downloads, private prompts, physical effects or live model campaigns
validation: Protocol package integrity, adapter/CLI cross-boundary tests and selected existing policy fixture
Backlog, queue, roadmap, typecheck and required scoped CI
escalation: Stop on unknown model consumption or configuration identity
Keep live-model evidence separate from scripted system passes

effort.basis: Completed before featurePlans adoption; original effort unmeasured.
